name: dsh-html-panel
description: 大管家 (Butler Console): a DSH sidebar entry that opens a standalone HTML console page served by this plugin's own Host route and shown in an iframe. Three columns — five-page navigation (butler/tasks/cluster/memory/settings), a DSH-style conversation page whose composer hosts real quick actions, and a right-hand T0→T1→T2→T3 dispatch hierarchy built from live sessions, real subagent lineage (session origin/parentSession) and interconnect.list() for peers. Same-origin read-only routes: api/cluster, api/board, api/host, api/tiers; the only write path is POST api/action with a whitelisted action id.
